title: Title 49, United States Code, Subtitle VII (Aviation Programs), ss. 41712 and 42305 (s. 42305 added by the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024)
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 49 U.S.C. 42305, headed 'Refunds for cancelled or significantly delayed or changed flights', with source credit Pub. L. 118-63 s. 503(a), May 16, 2024. Also fetched 49 U.S.C. 41712, headed 'Unfair and deceptive practices and unfair methods of competition'.
notes: Title 49 is a positive-law title, so the Code text itself is the law. Federal law requires refunds, not EU-style fixed compensation. Most detail is in DOT regulations: 14 CFR Part 260 (refunds), Part 250 (denied boarding compensation) and Part 259. Airline economic regulation preempts state law (49 U.S.C. 41713).
